summary: Independent W4 audit passed for the oRTP native-test completion candidate against 90261cae. P0=0 and P1=0. The original upstream placeholder case and the installed API consumer actually ran on native OHOS; their counts and coverage limitations are stated accurately.

additional_inputs: original upstream tester/ortp_tester.c, tester/fec_tester.c and tester/CMakeLists.txt
existing SONAME patch and consumer recipe/source
W3 marker, complete W3 log, positive Conan log and fetched candidate inputs
scope.mutations: Only this audit report was created; no source, marker, logs, staging or remote state was changed.

checks.atomicity: All candidate changes belong to oRTP and its package metadata. No shared infrastructure modification was found.
checks.test_integrity: 0005 changes CMake framework wiring only. It does not modify, replace or delete upstream test sources or assertions. The imported tester target links the published bctoolbox tester archive, bctoolbox and bcunit::bcunit.
checks.failure_propagation: build() runs the original ortp_tester through self.run without exception suppression. Its loader path includes the current build/src and host dependency libraries. The installed consumer propagates execution and loopback-bind failures.
checks.dependencies: The device dependency log records a real bcunit/5.3.113 binary download and bctoolbox/5.3.115 package contents including libbctoolbox-tester.a and bctoolbox/tester.h. BCUnit is a test requirement.
checks.soname_scope: The existing explicit relative SONAME libortp.so is restricted to the shared target on HarmonyOS/OHOS.
checks.package_scope: The build-time tester is removed from packaged bin; package_type remains library. The observed no-bin L2 skip is appropriate and is not counted as a passed runtime test.
checks.status_accuracy: Software/version manifests say built and do not claim publication. README distinguishes historical 5.5.0/pkg-config records from the current Conan package. Notes, test manifest, test report and PR body distinguish native W3 evidence from pending new-head remote CI.
checks.patch_and_whitespace: 0005 git apply --check passed on the supplied exact-source tree with the preceding adaptations. git diff --check 90261cae passed.

w3_log.observed: setup.sh RC=0; build_and_test.sh RC=0; G0/KC/JC/L0/L1/L4/L5 pass; L2 skip because no delivered bin; destructive negative package-dependency check confirmed; final build summary Success 1, Failed 0

positive_conan_log.observed: Original ortp_tester built and executed; FEC/first passed; tests Total 1, Ran 1, Passed 1, Failed 0, Inactive 0. Installed consumer executed API calls and printed consumer test: PASS.

candidate_matches_executed_inputs.comparison: SHA256 of all executable recipe/source inputs compared byte-for-byte with fetched W3 inputs; all nine matched. Subsequent test MANIFEST changes describe evidence only.

limitations: FEC/first only initializes an int pointer to NULL and asserts it is NULL. Preserving and running it validates the original tester/framework path, not FEC algorithms.

The meaningful package API consumer covers initialization, scheduler/session configuration, loopback binding and destruction. It does not establish real RTP send/receive interoperability or comprehensive behavior coverage.
Evidence covers the default native OHOS Release shared configuration. Static and cross configurations were not validated by this run.
The new candidate head still requires its own remote CI/review and release verification. Neither previous CI nor this audit establishes publication.
This audit inspected supplied native execution evidence and recomputed its hashes; the auditor did not independently rerun the device build.
